about: License texts for Rust crates linked into the desktop shell that ship no license file of their own (desktop-app ticket 26; the user's decision of 2026-10-15: version-qualified upstream texts, as packages/app/licenses/runtime-licenses.json does for npm packages). Each entry is tied to one exact crate version: when Cargo.lock moves the crate to another version, shell-notices.mjs fails until the text is checked again. The commit is the one the crate was published from (its .cargo_vcs_info.json on crates.io). kind: upstream-file = the repository's license file at that commit; no-upstream-text = the repository has no license text at that commit and only says the license's name (README, file headers), so the SPDX text of the declared license is shipped with that statement.
